message.content:
The query should return an empty result set because no country has both a singer older than 40 and a singer younger than 30.

FINAL SQL:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT s1.Country
FROM singer s1
WHERE s1.Age > 40
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM singer s2
    WHERE s2.Country = s1.Country
      AND s2.Age < 30
  );
```
